## What

Brief description of the change.

## Why

The problem this solves or the behavior it changes.

## Testing

How you verified it — which test layer, which `make` targets.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated in the right layer
- [ ] `make lint && make complexity && make coverage` passes
- [ ] Docs updated if public behavior changed
- [ ] Security impact noted if this touches the microVM boundary, policy, credentials, the audit chain, or host IPC
